title: DeliciousShoesHD/Kick/Abusing ./report

replies.author: EncryptedShoesHD
replies.body:
Hey Dokihl!

Look. You reported someone for four times. When the first report came, I was away from keyboard because I had to do something else, but then I came back and checked your second report. After I took over your report, I told you that I am already spectating the reported player but then for unknown reason you reported him again for 2 times.

I think that the kick was the right action to perform because you've been warned about the same thing on "December 9, 2015 at 2:40 AM" by GuyNamedRiley. Take a look at it: http://imgur.com/tC0WQfM ! And because it was your second offense, according to the new punishment guidelines, the kick should be the right action to perform. Take a look at this image: http://imgur.com/Rd9ayUj

Your image which you posted on gyazo (https://gyazo.com/6559d6fea65861502e940c0a84f7980f) shows you something that shouldn't happen (This is probably a bug). I can prove that I only kicked you once and not for 3 times. My first evidence to prove this is image posted here: http://imgur.com/RtkzUce
I am 100% sure that DEVs and other staff members can also prove this as bug (maybe not all of them, but some of them probably can).

If there's anything that you want to discuss about, feel free to contact me on ts or reply here.


Regards,
DeliciousShoesHD!
